run_allegro_hand_hw_test: run the allegro hand hardware test script that connects to a robot via localhost
create_robot_interface: create a RobotInterface instance connected to localhost for controlling the Allegro Hand robot
get_joint_positions: get the current joint positions of the Allegro Hand robot using the RobotInterface
go_home: command the Allegro Hand robot to move to its home position via RobotInterface
move_to_joint_positions: move the Allegro Hand robot to specified joint positions using a PyTorch tensor
